purpose: Audit every saved miss and test one consistent-quality gate substitution with exact frozen grouped OOF forest scores and original thresholds. No forest fitting, new features, model selection, engine queries or deployment.
data: 3724 moves,917 positive,2807 negative,972 game/position groups; all included, no truth-based selection.
primary: Original custom_retuned arm with its existing inner-training-selected threshold in each of five outer folds versus same scores/cutoffs and root-consistent quality gate.
secondary: Original custom_fixed5/6 versus same gate substitution; control only, no selection of winning arm.
candidate: If complete played-root scores and same_root_loss_pp exist in BOTH windows, use same_root_loss_pp<=5 instead of mapped_loss_pp<=5 in each external eligibility quality check. Otherwise retain original policy for the entire pair.
unchanged: All75 original forest feature values, missing indicators, saved per-move minimum OOF scores, per-fold cutoffs, raw_offer, after_floor>=-100, two_roots, window completeness, confidence_sufficient and physical_unknown. No losing-mate remapping change.
evaluation: Exact same outer group hashes/splits, alias/game/canonical-position grouping and both windows. Original three-inner-fold choices frozen; no new threshold selection requires rerunning inner folds. Each original training fit excluded its entire outer test groups.
success: Primary must increase pooled TP with FP count no higher AND wrong fraction of awards no higher than paired original; report all gained/lost true/wrong awards, including failed criterion. Do not retune after outcomes.
audit: Misses partitioned by gate-only, score-only, both; overlapping gate reasons; score shortfalls in fixed0.025/0.05/0.10 descriptive bins; label-stratified coverage and gate transitions.
uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-group bootstrap draws, seed20261104, conditional on saved predictions. No independent new-data claim.
limits: Original training excluded ineligible rows; newly admitted rows have a changed eligibility distribution. Forest feature inputs still contain original loss values. This isolates the external gate, not wholesale evaluation replacement or search accuracy. Repeatedly studied enriched data.
resources: No new engine calls or fits; one evaluation run, no outcome retries. NumPy from existing venv.
